newsitem.title: USA: Storage expects mainframe tape revs to rise.
newsitem.headline: Storage expects mainframe tape revs to rise.

text.p: Storage Technology Corp said on Thursday that it expected revenues on its mainframe tape component to improve during the second quarter.
"Given the strong backlogs and activity levels, we expect the mainframe tape component of our revenue to improve in the current quarter," the company said in a statement.

It added, "we continue to extend our leadership position with the recent introduction of a new, higher-speed version of our flagship tape library, PowderHorn, and with expanded configurability options for our high-end tape drives."
The company also said that during the first quarter it had "experienced excellent growth and substantial margin improvement in our online business, both mainframe and open systems."
It added that revenue contributions from tape products for new applications and open systems also improved.
Storage Technology provides network computing storage. It reported earnings of $180.3 million on revenue of $2.04 billion in 1996.
